skills.name: assessment/repository-discovery
skills.description: Discovers repository structure, language mix, and scanner inputs. Produces a partial RepositoryAssessmentV1.

skills.name: assessment/dependency-scan
skills.description: Scans NuGet, vcpkg, and native package manifests to produce dependency findings with ARM64 status.

skills.name: assessment/code-compatibility-scan
skills.description: Scans source for x86/x64-specific intrinsics, inline asm, and hard-coded architecture conditionals.

skills.name: assessment/build-readiness-scan
skills.description: Inspects project files, solutions, and CI workflows to determine ARM64 build coverage.

skills.name: assessment/windows-experience-audit
skills.description: Audits installer, packaging manifest, and Windows integration surfaces (notifications, lifecycle).

skills.name: assessment/accessibility-audit
skills.description: Audits UI accessibility patterns and evidence (UI Automation, keyboard, high-contrast). Coverage is heuristic: 'partial' when accessibility hints found, 'unknown' otherwise.

skills.name: build/add-arm64-target
skills.description: Adds ARM64 configurations to MSBuild projects and solution platform mappings. Currently handles Dockerfile, .csproj, and .vcxproj inputs.

skills.name: build/add-arm64ec-target
skills.description: Adds Arm64EC configurations to native/mixed MSBuild projects for staged migration.

skills.name: build/toolchain-upgrade
skills.description: Upgrades Directory.Build.props/targets and SDK/toolset versions to an ARM64-capable toolchain.

skills.name: packaging/add-arm64-msix
skills.description: Adds ARM64 processor architecture entries and bundle mappings to MSIX packaging.

skills.name: packaging/wix-arm64
skills.description: Adds ARM64 packaging to WiX installers, including platform-specific components and bundle chains.

skills.name: pipeline/github-actions-arm64-job
skills.description: Adds an ARM64 build/test job to GitHub Actions workflows with matching runner labels.

skills.name: pipeline/azure-pipelines-arm64-stage
skills.description: Adds an ARM64 stage to Azure Pipelines definitions with the appropriate pool selector.

skills.name: pipeline/matrix-fanout
skills.description: Fans an existing single-architecture build job into an x64+ARM64 matrix without duplicating steps.

skills.name: code/sse-to-neon-porting
skills.description: Ports SSE/AVX intrinsics to NEON equivalents behind an architecture-aware header shim.

skills.name: code/arch-conditional-cleanup
skills.description: Refactors hard-coded x64-only conditionals into architecture-agnostic or ARM64-aware branches. A generic AI code transformer (CodePatcher) exists but has no skill-specific rules yet, so this remains declared-only until a deterministic or skill-scoped implementation lands.

skills.name: code/pinvoke-arm64-shim
skills.description: Introduces a P/Invoke shim layer that routes calls to an ARM64-native or Arm64EC-compatible library.

skills.name: dependency/source-build
skills.description: Rebuilds a source-available dependency for ARM64 and publishes a locally consumable package.

skills.name: dependency/replace-x64-only
skills.description: Swaps an x64-only dependency for an ARM64-capable replacement identified during the dependency scan.

skills.name: validation/build-arm64
skills.description: Builds the ARM64 (and Arm64EC where applicable) configuration and captures build logs.

skills.name: validation/smoke-test
skills.description: Runs the ARM64 smoke test suite and captures a test report.

skills.name: validation/emulation-perf-baseline
skills.description: Runs an emulated x64 vs native ARM64 performance baseline for the primary binary.
